method: KEX-QA-02: re-checks the GPT-BARS-001 withheld Pasteur Street branches against the official taproom directory and OpenStreetMap. Coordinates are taken only from a mapped OSM object that matches the official street/building and ward (no interpolation between house numbers, no street-segment points). 221 Hoàng Sa stays withheld: no mapped POI or house number, and its street points span three wards.

venues.name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer – Bùi Viện

offerings.evidence: The official Pasteur Street taproom directory lists the Bùi Viện Taproom & Restaurant at 212 Đề Thám, Bến Thành Ward, serving its craft beer.

venues.note: Coordinates: OpenStreetMap node 13541335701 'Pasteur Street Craft Beer' (amenity=bar) on Đề Thám, Phường Bến Thành — same street and ward as the official directory; the node has no house number. Replaces the street-segment point rejected in GPT-BARS-001.

venues.name: Pasteur Street Craft Beer – Phú Mỹ Hưng

offerings.evidence: The official Pasteur Street taproom directory lists the Phu My Hung Taproom & Restaurant at CR5-01, Crescent Residence 5 (near Crescent Mall and SECC), serving its craft beer.

venues.note: Coordinates: OpenStreetMap way 1510577907 'Crescent Residence 5' (building, 8 Trần Văn Trà, Phường Tân Mỹ) — building-level pin for shop unit CR5-01; the street number comes from OSM, not the official directory.
